caption: Monte San Salvatore, Lugano
composition: Summit of Monte San Salvatore looking north over Lugano and the lake · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Monte San Salvatore is the steep cone south of Lugano, and this view is from the summit, where a small church stands beside the funicular arrival, looking north over the city and the lake toward Monte Brè. The shore walk and the view from Monte Brè are other scenes. At about 912 metres in late September the summit is rock and chestnut woodland rather than a winter snowfield. The Open-Meteo model is partly cloudy, with sun through broken cloud and no rain.
